ValidationRule.description: Restricts manual 'Lead Source' options for sales profiles.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(LeadSource)), OR($Profile.Name = "JJD - Sales Area Manager", $Profile.Name = "JJD - Sales Manager", $Profile.Name = "JJD - Sales Manager Vending", $Profile.Name = "JJD - KAM", $Profile.Name = "JJD - National Sales Manager"), NOT(ISPICKVAL(LeadSource, "Employee Referral")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(LeadSource, "Cold Acquisition")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(LeadSource, "Partner Referral")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(LeadSource, "Trade Fair")))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: When created manually, the Lead Source is restricted to Employee/Partner Referral, Cold Acquisition, or Trade Fair.
